secrets.name: MAIL_USERNAME
secrets.description: Gmail address for Flask-Mail SMTP (email features). Optional — not required to boot.

secrets.name: MAIL_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Gmail app password for Flask-Mail SMTP. Optional — not required to boot.

secrets.name: BREVO_API_KEY
secrets.description: Brevo (Sendinblue) API key starting with xkeysib-... for transactional email via brevo_mail.py. Optional.

secrets.name: SENDER_EMAIL
secrets.description: Brevo-verified sender email address for transactional email. Optional.

secrets.name: SENDER_NAME
secrets.description: Display name shown to email recipients (defaults to 'Student OS'). Optional.
